payload.title: FR-279 native subscribe-acks (Swift/Kotlin) — additive, with test harness
payload.description: The native half of FR-279 was reverted (1252d3d) because making the existing subscribe/subscribeObject/subscribeProjection methods block-until-snapshot deadlocked the Swift suite (every test driving a mock socket that doesn't echo a Snapshot hangs). Redo it ADDITIVELY: add NEW awaitable methods (e.g. subscribeObjectRegistered) that resolve on the initial Snapshot/StreamPage/ProjectionDelta correlated by subscriptionId (objects/streams) / projection name, leaving the existing fire-and-send subscribe methods unchanged. Update the Swift + Android test harness to capture the sent subscriptionId and deliver a correlating Snapshot so the awaitable path is testable. The web half (packages/core) is already done + verified; mirror its design. Relates to FR-279/FR-256.
